## Context / Problem
The completed fix on reportable-chalkstony-eeve skips full-history commit discovery only when accepted-scope file impact is empty. Impact-present closes still run the same unbounded path, and current end-to-end telemetry shows it now dominates the user-visible close command.

Frozen Codex-rollout sample (2026-08-22 through 2026-08-23T21:15Z), limited to canonical tracker closes with a matched Bedrock COMPLETION_VERDICT and metrics.llm_calls > 0: n=10 completed closes, p50=28.24m, p90=57.32m, p99=61.60m. The matched completion-verifier workflows themselves are generally 1-4m; recent 25-62m closes spend most of their time before the verifier sidecar.

Static mechanism: close_precheck._check_work_landed calls commit_impact.referencing_commits for every impact-present close. That helper reads all 2,690 commits and extract_ticket_refs produces 2,229 unique historical candidates. 702 candidates require alias/prefix resolution; _scan_alias walks the current 5,351-ticket store for each, implying roughly 3.8 million ticket-directory visits before completion verification. Ordinary subject prefixes and deprecated four-digit references enter the candidate set. This is the residual impact-present case left explicitly unchanged by reportable-chalkstony-eeve.

Post-diagnosis refinement: the alias sub-case was bounded by the sibling fix 4234-821b (commit 5c64deff, one alias-index build). The residual proven at runtime is that resolve_ticket_id's 8-hex short-id branch and its generic >=4-char prefix branch still call os.listdir(tracker_dir) once per candidate, so non-alias candidates (short-id-shaped tokens, ordinary subject prefixes, deprecated four-digit fragments) still scale O(unique_candidates x tracker).

## Plan
- Add a deterministic performance reproduction for an impact-present close with many historical reference candidates and a large tracker.
- Replace per-candidate full-store short-id/prefix resolution with a single indexed resolution strategy while preserving every accepted commit-ticket reference form and ambiguity behavior.
- Keep descendant credit, attached commits, --ref behavior, file-impact-vs-diff enforcement, and fail-closed git-error semantics unchanged.
- Measure the repaired pre-verifier scan and pin a scaling assertion that prevents history x tracker behavior from returning.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Impact-present close commit discovery does not perform a full tracker walk per unique historical candidate.
- [x] The scan cost is bounded to one tracker index/build per invocation plus linear code-history parsing.
- [x] Full, two-quad short, alias, Jira, compatibility four-digit/prefix, trailer, and leading-subject reference forms retain current matching and ambiguity semantics.
- [x] Descendant ticket credit remains covered end to end.
- [x] File-impact-vs-diff enforcement remains covered end to end.
- [x] A scale-focused regression test fails on the current history-times-tracker implementation and passes on the repair.
- [x] Before/after wall-time and scan-count evidence is recorded on this ticket.

## Testing
- Verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py::test_referencing_commits_bounded_scans_for_non_alias_candidates` — RED-first scan-count regression (counts tracker-root `os.listdir` calls; fails on the per-candidate implementation, passes bounded at <=1 on the repair).
- Verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py::test_indexed_short_id_and_prefix_resolution_matches_per_call` — indexed short-id / generic-prefix / ambiguous-prefix resolution equals per-call scanning (AC#3).
- Verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py -k "resolver_scan_index or falls_back or work_landed"` — None-on-hard-failure fail-open contract, per-call fallback crediting, and descendant-credit / file-impact-vs-diff end-to-end checks.
- Verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_referencing_commits_alias_scan_perf.py` — the alias-branch bound and indexed/per-call parity remain green.
- Gates: checked with `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`.
- Before/after scan-count evidence recorded as a ticket comment (82 -> 1 tracker-root scans for 80 distinct non-alias candidates, target still credited).
